description: This file contains functions and classes for verifying system and environment compatibility for PyTorch Dynamo, including CUDA, ROCm, and Python version checks, as well as a main function to run all checks.

classes.name: VerifyDynamoError
classes.description: Custom exception class for verification errors.

methods.name: check_python
methods.description: Checks if the current Python version meets the minimum requirement.

methods.name: get_cuda_version
methods.description: Retrieves the CUDA version using nvcc and torch utilities.

methods.name: get_rocm_version
methods.description: Retrieves the ROCm version using hipcc and torch utilities.

methods.name: check_cuda
methods.description: Checks CUDA availability and version compatibility.

methods.name: check_rocm
methods.description: Checks ROCm availability and version compatibility.

methods.name: check_dynamo
methods.description: Performs a test to verify if PyTorch Dynamo is functioning with specified backend and device.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Runs all environment and system checks and outputs results.
